info.description: ZICK — A spiritual-wellness app backend providing auth, content, schedules, and subscriptions.
info.title: ZICK API

get.description: Root endpoint — confirms the API is running.

post.description: Admin endpoint to create a new motivation.

put.description: Admin endpoint to update an existing motivation.

delete.description: Admin endpoint to delete an existing motivation.

post.description: Authenticates an admin using hardcoded credentials. Returns access + refresh JWT pair.
Sends a 5-digit OTP to the email (10-min expiry). Always returns 200 to prevent user enumeration.
Authenticates an EMAIL user. Returns access + refresh JWT pair. Available languages: en (English), fr (French), es (Spanish), pt (Portuguese), ht (Haitian Creole).
Revokes the current refresh token, ending the session.
Rotates the refresh token: revokes the old one and issues a new access + refresh pair. Token may be sent in body or "refresh_token" cookie.

Creates a new EMAIL-provider account. Returns access + refresh JWT pair. Duplicate email returns 409. Available languages: en (English), fr (French), es (Spanish), pt (Portuguese), ht (Haitian Creole). Available auth providers: EMAIL, GOOGLE, APPLE.
Verifies the 5-digit OTP and updates the user password.
Authenticates a user using Firebase ID token (Google or Apple). Returns access + refresh JWT pair.

get.description: Returns a paginated, filterable list of content items. Supports `type`, `sub_type`, `audience`, `category_tag`, and `q` (full-text search) query parameters.

parameters.description: Content type (PRAYER, MOTIVATION, WORSHIP, PROVERB, DAILY_QUOTE, ILLUSTRATION, ENCOURAGEMENT)
parameters.name: type

get.description: Returns the DAILY_QUOTE content item for the current date, filtered by published_at.
Returns full detail for a content item. If the content is premium and the user is not premium, returns HTTP 403 with an upgrade prompt.
Returns a list of content items related to the given content ID via the related_content join table.

post.description: Registers or refreshes an FCM (Android) or APNs (iOS) push notification token. Upserts on (user_id, token). Available platforms: IOS, ANDROID.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of motivation items. Supports search, sort, and pagination via query params.

parameters.description: Search by title or speaker name
parameters.name: search

parameters.description: Sort column; prefix with - for DESC (e.g. -created_at)
parameters.name: sort

get.description: Retrieves details of a specific motivation along with related motivations.
Returns the authenticated user's prayer schedule. Creates a default schedule on first access (05:00 morning, 21:00 night, UTC, push enabled) rather than returning 404.

put.description: Updates morning_prayer_time, night_prayer_time, timezone (must be valid IANA string), and push_enabled for the authenticated user.

get.description: Returns all active subscription plans (Biannual, Annual, Friends & Family).

post.description: Verifies an Apple or Google Play receipt, upserts a subscription record, and marks the user as premium. Receipt validation is currently stubbed — real integration pending.
Receives renewal, cancellation, and refund events from Apple and Google. No auth middleware — store signature verification is applied instead (currently stubbed with a TODO).

parameters.description: Webhook payload from Apple or Google
parameters.name: request

post.description:
Uploads any file (image, audio, etc.) to Cloudinary and returns the public URL.
Pass an optional `folder` query parameter to organise assets (e.g. `?folder=content/thumbnails`).
The returned `url` can be stored and referenced by any domain (content, profile, etc.).

delete.description:
Permanently removes a file from Cloudinary using its public_id.
The public_id is returned by POST /api/v1/upload.

get.description: Returns the full profile and settings for the authenticated user.

put.description: Updates name, location, theme preference (Available: LIGHT, DARK), or language preference. Duplicate email returns 409. Available languages: en (English), fr (French), es (Spanish), pt (Portuguese), ht (Haitian Creole).

delete.description: Soft-deletes the authenticated user's account (sets deleted_at). No hard purge occurs synchronously.

post.description: Uploads a new profile picture (JPEG/PNG/WebP, max 5 MB) to Cloudinary and updates avatar_url.

put.description: Verifies the current password and updates it to the new one.

get.description: Returns API metadata and database connectivity status.

receipt_payload.description: Raw receipt string / token from the store

limit.description: Limit is the number of items per page.

page.description: Page is the current page number (1-indexed).

total.description: Total is the total number of matching records.

total_pages.description: TotalPages is the total number of pages.
